title: GTA 6 Running Log
summary: A running, topic-organised log of GTA 6 facts from our chats plus researched codes, locations, and secrets. Progress: Chapter 1, up to Discharge Time. Updated 21 Nov 2026, Australia/Brisbane.
calloutBody: Items marked Our chats came from Tyas in this conversation and are listed exactly as given. Items with a link were added from post-launch guides and should be treated as community-sourced until confirmed in-game. Ordinary store-robbery keypad codes are randomised and are not listed. This page was built as the first research update on 21 Nov 2026, Australia/Brisbane.

properties.label: Official patches
properties.value: None published as of this date; latest reported build is 01.002.001 (16 Nov, pre-launch)

footer: This is a living log. Future updates should edit this same Page rather than creating a new one.

categories.heading: Codes
categories.caption: Safe, door, and keypad codes. Tyas's three Port Gellhorn codes match launch guides. Mission codes are generally fixed; free-roam store safes are not.

items.note: Office in the northeast corner; enter the leading zero. Also on the Brooks Boatworks wall map.
Main warehouse safe, Port Gellhorn. Upstairs wall map here also reveals the other two Port Gellhorn codes.
Port Gellhorn illegal operation. Shown on the Brooks Boatworks wall map.
Key Lento shop that fronts the acid lab, Chapter 1 mission Lab Fees. Clerk tells you, or it is on a notepad.
Key Lento fence drop, unlocked in Lab Fees. Green icon on the map.
Pelican Valley research outpost. Turn power on outside; password is written on a side-room floor.
Double the successful specimen ID 0036 from the lab report. Cash and the dock code are inside.
Code is inside the outpost safe; opens the dock building that holds the Crabshack VF5.
Vice City, small back office. Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs (Chapter 3); buffalo skull chain.
Downtown Vice City, northeast corner of the middle room. Diamond ring.
Vice City rear room; enter the leading zero. Amethyst necklace.
The Hamlet, room next to the garage; code is written on the wall.
Five-digit code on a sandbar-island trailer south of Cottonmouth Lake (one guide also says Key Lento). Code is among the postcards.
Northeast of Cottonmouth Lake; basement door to an underground facility. Do not confuse with a separate dream-puzzle keypad.
Leonard County, back room behind a red door. Listed as confirmed by Consolyte; not on every two-source roundup.
Wall panel, during the mission First Impressions. Consolyte listing; not on every two-source roundup.

categories.heading: Weapon Locations
categories.caption: Unique or notable pickups. Guides say unique variants stay unlocked and can be recovered from an Ammu-Nation locker. There are many more in the world than are listed here.

items.location: Kingpin Bowling, pool table, northeast corner
items.note: Unique pump-action shotgun. One of three valuables for the Let's Go Bowling trophy; unlocked after Coffee Break in Chapter 2.

items.location: Brooks Boatworks, room with the wall map
items.note: Unique assault rifle on the table in front of the whiteboard, same room as the Port Gellhorn code map.

items.location: Pelican Valley crab research outpost, dock building
items.note: Unique SMG beside a body after using codes CLEAVES, 0072, then 0212. Available in Chapter 1.
On the blood-covered cabin floor; the Cruel Huntsman's SM-69 is on the back porch of the same cabin.

items.location: Same Pelican Valley cabin, back porch
items.note: Unique sniper; grab nearby sniper ammo before leaving. Watch for alligators.

items.location: Trunk of Donnie's Dinka Blista, mission Don Gone
items.note: Missable: take it from the trunk before you destroy the car. Don Gone is Chapter 1 mission 18, so this may already be past.

items.location: Roadside encounter south of Hamlet, near Grassrivers
items.note: Help two hunters (one injured), return their truck, and take the injured hunter to hospital to receive this sniper.

items.location: Industrial storage building south of Hamlet, near the highway
items.note: Unique shotgun in a weapon case inside; cash is on a nearby table and in a yellow toolbox.

items.location: Waterfront building, Kingfishers fishing compound, Wetman Bay
items.note: Scoped, suppressed small-game rifle in a case on a desk; approach the docks by boat.

items.location: Underground bunker under an antenna-covered RV, Balsero junkyard
items.note: Southwest of Griffin Shooting Range. KeenGamer says this opens after a Chapter 1 job it names Building a Life, which is not on the main mission lists.
Free rocket launcher with four rockets, plus other supplies in the same hatch.

items.location: Derelict spy vessel, southern tip of the southeastern Permit Keys island
items.note: Through the hatch in the middle of the deck, east of Mile Zero Air Station.

items.location: Northernmost Permit Keys island, in the sand beside a tilted smuggler boat
items.note: Unique shotgun lying outside the hull; no hidden compartment needed.

items.location: Underwater off the northern coast of Riquezas Keys
items.note: Dive at the floating drug packages to a sunken speedboat; the unique AR is beneath it.

items.location: Bobcat Bight, Capri Island, Mariana County
items.note: Shoot the lines of a paramotor caught in coastal pines, then loot the wreckage on the ground.

items.location: Bret Vogel hunting quest, Lummox County
items.note: Chapter 2 after Coffee Break: Jason gets a message from Bret and receives this sniper when Veteran Hunted starts.

items.location: Entrance of Pegassi Residences east tower, Bayside Drive, Tequesta Retreat

categories.heading: Easter Eggs and Hidden Content
categories.caption: Secrets and references. Arthur's hat, Dexter's apartment, the ASSMAN Phoenix, the Penumbra FF, and the painted-egg nest were requested; the rest are researched additions.

categories.heading: Shop and Facility Locations
categories.caption: Mod shops, fences, and other useful stops. Fence rates vary by goods type; PC Gamer says to check each fence on the map.

items.note: Dirt-bike mod shop (parts and all-terrain cosmetics). A trailer park sits behind it; Whisler Motorsport is nearby.
First goods fence, unlocked in Lab Fees. Drop-box payout, not instant. Takes narcotics, jewelry, and marked bills.

items.note: Unlocked after Clean Up After Donnie.

items.location: Port Gellhorn, Kelly County; drop box in his car trunk

items.location: Little Cuba, Vice City; shop, immediate sale
items.note: Unlocked in Chapter 3 (Boobie Time). After two Payday Loan jobs, garage pickup is available for a fee.

items.location: Garage in Port Gellhorn, Kelly County
items.note: Vehicle buyer, unlocked in the Chapter 2 mission Moses.
High-end vehicle buyer, unlocked in Chapter 3.
Mod shop; one guide used it to change headlights and bodywork on Jason's truck.

items.note: Respray and register stolen cars; also the landmark used to place Brooks Boatworks and Dexter's block.
Buy sticky bombs and refill body armor; unique weapons can be retrieved from lockers once unlocked.
Racing shop close to the dirt-bike shop, per the Dirt Merchants map card.
Also holds windows, hazards, trunk or tailgate, and vehicle-specific options such as a pickup tailgate.

items.location: Vehicle tab: Automatic, Low Beam, High Beam, or Off
items.note: Same hold-Left menu as above; right stick up if you land on Radio first.
Some guides say a short tap toggles lights; a hold ducks instead. Use the menu for high beams.
A tap signals; holding Left opens the menu instead.

items.location: Click L3 (PS5) or left stick (Xbox) in a police vehicle
items.note: Toggles the siren and light bar together. Left stick up is the manual siren tone; down is the horn. No confirmed lights-only toggle.
Grab a vehicle and lose the two-star wanted level.
Quiet way out of the bowling alley compound.
Highlights nearby notes, maps, and keypad clues. You can also aim at an employee and ask for a safe code.

items.location: Sticky bombs, or the right-stick crack prompt
items.note: Explosives can damage some contents and will alert enemies. Many operation sites have bomb crates nearby, or buy them at Ammu-Nation.
GameSpot found ordinary store and robbery keypad codes change between visits, so lists cannot give those numbers.
Some pay at a drop box later, others pay immediately. You can also send your partner to fence goods for a smaller cut.

items.location: Finish the main story at least once
items.note: Then open the phone, hold L1 + R1, and enter a D-pad sequence. Using a cheat disables saving afterwards. Many cheats also need a challenge completed.

items.location: $250,000: Up, Right, Down, Left, Up, Left, Down, Right
items.note: The only money cheat GameSpot lists. Story must already be finished; do not use it if you still want to save.

steps.title: Open the vehicle menu
steps.detail: While in a vehicle, hold D-pad Left. If Radio opens first, push the right stick up to switch to the Vehicle tab.

steps.title: Headlights and the light bar
steps.detail: In the Vehicle tab, set Headlights to Automatic, Low Beam, High Beam, or Off. In a police vehicle, click L3 (PS5) or the left stick (Xbox) to toggle the siren and light bar together.

steps.title: Kingpin Bowling escape
steps.detail: Front parking lot for a car getaway, or stealth out via the rear fence. Leaving triggers a two-star wanted level.

categories.heading: Glitches and Bugs
categories.caption: Every entry from the hourly scan file /workspace/gta6-glitches/seen.json (last scan 20 Nov 2026, 8:10 PM Australia/Brisbane), plus one new report found on 21 Nov. No official Rockstar patch notes or known-issues list as of 21 Nov 2026, Australia/Brisbane. Latest reported official build remains 01.002.001 (16 Nov, pre-launch). A 1.002.002 report is unofficial and unconfirmed.

items.item: Prologue: Lucia falls through the map after being tased
items.note: Often teleports back to the police sequence; otherwise restart or replay the mission.

items.item: Gone Fishing: boat ram has no NPC or vehicle reaction
items.note: Ramming a speedboat into an NPC boat produced no crash, capsize, or reaction.

items.item: Gone Fishing: missing plane door / clip into seat
items.note: No door-opening animation; Jason clips through the fuselage into the pilot seat.
A can or bottle pops into existence instead of coming off a shelf.

items.item: Stolen plane crash: no explosion, unharmed exit
items.location: Police chase in a large plane
items.note: Shot-down plane does not break apart as expected; player exits unharmed.

items.location: Fight with an officer, reported in a station / around a couch
items.note: Characters overlap and get sucked into furniture or a wall; reports say letting it play out usually frees you.

items.location: Hitting a swing set or similar object
items.note: Vehicle can be launched a long way and wrecked. Not confirmed as a repeatable exploit.

items.location: Jumping out of a plane early
items.note: Abandoned plane can lose physics and phase through buildings.

items.item: Survive a plane bailout with no parachute or damage
items.location: Police chase, jumping with no chute
items.note: Player lands unharmed; in the reported clip the plane itself does explode.

items.item: Lucia falls through terrain, dies, respawns elsewhere
items.note: Related to, but described differently from, the prologue taser clip. Exact trigger not clearly documented.

Includes a boat jammed in a Keys-style bridge, a passenger stuck in an Annis Hellion door, cage-mesh camera clip, tattoo-studio counter clip, bodies sinking into asphalt, and Lucia falling through a prison floor.

items.location: Intro / just before the prologue; reported on Xbox Series X
items.note: Vehicles and NPCs pop in and world textures go missing.

items.location: Free roam on a mobility scooter
items.note: Reported as unusually hard to crash; may be exaggerated physics rather than a classic glitch.

items.item: Ship / vehicle pop-in on a bridge
items.location: Driving on a bridge (one writeup: Drive to the radar station)
items.note: A ship or stacked vehicles appear jammed against or on the bridge, then shift oddly.

items.item: NPCs walk into walls and get stuck
items.note: Minor, not game-breaking; seen in pre-release reviews, not confirmed fixed on the launch build.

items.item: Floating coffee cup when switching characters
items.note: Shacknews reported an otherwise clean review apart from this one visual bug.

items.item: Phone in a tight spot drops Jason through the map
items.location: Squeeze between a car and a fence, then open the phone
items.note: A restart was reportedly needed; make a manual save first. Original post was not independently found by the scan.

items.item: Crashes or reboots wiping progress despite autosave
items.note: Reported progress loss after a crash or reboot even with autosave.
A truck is launched a long distance after a collision.
Dexerto describes a glitch that lets players access first-person mode; details beyond the headline were not in the scan file.

items.location: Red barn stash; PS5 / Xbox Series
items.note: Cocaine or cash respawns after a manual save and reload if bags stay in the vehicle trunk; fence at Brian's Lockup. Unpatched in the scan file.

items.item: Coming Home: pool break with Mattia does not register
items.note: Softlock when the pool shot does not register. From our chats and the scan file.

items.location: Early Lucia mission, after leaving a bank
items.note: Cutscene does not start; softlock.
Swimming animation plays on the wrong axis.
Player can get stuck inside a fenced area with no clear exit.

items.item: Boat wedged between bridge supports moves erratically
items.note: Wedged boat behaves oddly.

items.item: Riderless motorbikes keep chasing after a mission reset
items.note: Bikes continue the chase with no riders.

items.item: Traffic or cars vanish in front of the player
items.note: Vehicles despawn or disappear ahead of the camera.

items.item: Xbox flickering lighting and blocky textures
items.note: Lighting flicker and blocky or corrupted textures.

items.item: PS5 CE-108255-1 crash in the prologue
items.note: Crash with that error code. GamesRadar suggests updating the game; no official Rockstar notes.

items.item: NPC SUV frozen mid-air beside a Keys bridge
items.note: A traffic SUV hangs motionless in the air and despawns when you drive away.

items.item: Fishing rod falls through the boat and is lost
items.note: The rod clips through the hull and is lost.

items.item: Prologue: cannot aim at the cashier
items.note: LT / L2 does nothing when trying to aim at the cashier.

items.item: Gone Fishing: Jason stuck inside a cage
items.location: After the Kingfishers fight in Gone Fishing; PS5 and Xbox
items.note: Trapped in a wire-mesh cage with no exit. Workaround: retry the checkpoint, or load a save from before the mission. Found in the 21 Nov research update; not in the 20 Nov scan file.
